title: Five Education Numbers Show How Uneven School Scale Really Is
hook: School access expanded, but classroom pressure still varies wildly.
closing: Education grew, but scale still decides how much attention each student receives.
question: Which education gap surprised you most?

segments.say: India has 127.5 million secondary pupils, nearly double China. Education at this scale strains any school system.
In Guinea-Bissau, one college teacher faces 147.6 students, more than double the next worst country. Individual attention becomes scarce.
Education spending fell to 3.57 percent of national income, the lowest in this data. Growing systems have less room to improve.
Today, 92 percent of young women can read, up from about two thirds in 1975. Wider access produced real gains.
In Tanzania, one preschool teacher has 114 children, almost double the next worst country. The pressure starts before primary school.
